name: Grok Code Fast 1

lifecycle.note: Retired from the xAI API; requests to grok-code-fast-1 are served by grok-build-0.1.

released.note: Generally available on the xAI API and free for a limited time on launch-partner coding tools at announcement; xAI says it had quietly released the model under a codename the week before.

retired.note: Effective 12:00 PM PT on the xAI API.

summary.text: Grok Code Fast 1 is an xAI reasoning model for agentic coding, released on 28 August 2025 on the xAI API and, free for a limited time, through coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor. xAI says it built the model from scratch on a new architecture and trained it on programming content and real-world pull requests. It was retired from the API on 15 May 2026.

features.note: Built for agentic coding harnesses; xAI names tools such as grep, terminal and file editing.

access.note: Also offered through third-party coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Kilo Code, opencode, Windsurf); these are not cloud platforms, so they are not recorded as cloud-partner.

notes: Added by the verifier: missing from the research output. xAI calls it the start of a new model family built from scratch with a new architecture, so no predecessor relation is recorded. The retirement guide names grok-build-0.1 as its replacement; replacedBy is left out because no record id for Grok Build 0.1 is known in this chunk. familyId is null pending a curator decision (no xAI code family in the scope). Modalities and context window are left out: no live or verified archived primary page states them for grok-code-fast-1 (the current docs show it only as an alias of grok-build-0.1). The API alias grok-code-fast-1-0825 comes from the current Grok Build 0.1 model page alias list.
